name: Iguana
description: Connect your own self-hosted Iguana (iNTERFACEWARE) instance to manage channels from Imperal -- status/start/stop/start-all/stop-all, full channel configuration (add/update/remove, get/get-default config), Translator project export/import and milestones, server log queries, server configuration and performance stats, plus your my.interfaceware.com license entitlements (list/activate/check/transfer, and applying a license key to your instance). Your admin credentials are verified against your own instance before they're saved. Scoped to the fully-documented Iguana 6 HTTP API surface -- see this app's own settings screen for the IguanaX compatibility note.

tools.name: connect_iguana
tools.description: Connect your Iguana instance by saving its base URL plus an administrator username/password, after checking they actually work together.

base_url.description: Base URL of your Iguana instance, e.g. https://your-server.example.com:6543
base_url.title: Base Url

username.description: Iguana administrator username for this instance.
username.title: Username

password.description: Iguana administrator password for this instance.
password.title: Password

label.description: Optional friendly name for this instance connection.
label.title: Label

tools.name: disconnect_iguana
tools.description: Disconnect an Iguana instance: deletes the saved base URL/credentials. Nothing on the Iguana server itself is changed.

connection_id.description: ID of the connection to disconnect.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected Iguana instances.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

secrets.name: iguana_connections
secrets.description: Your connected Iguana instances -- stored as a JSON array, one entry per instance, each with its own base_url, administrator username, password, and an optional friendly label. Managed through connect_iguana / disconnect_iguana -- you should not need to edit this directly.

secrets.name: iguana_license_connections
secrets.description: Your saved my.interfaceware.com licensing portal logins -- stored as a JSON array, one entry per login, each with its own username, password, and an optional friendly label. Managed through connect_license_portal / disconnect_license_portal -- you should not need to edit this directly.

pricing.notes: Iguana instance and licensing-portal connect/disconnect/list-connections are free (local credential management, no third-party call charged). Plain reads against the connected instance or my.interfaceware.com are 8. Standard single-entity writes (channel create/update/remove, project milestone) are 16. Consequential single actions that change live running state or apply real licensing/import effects (license activate/transfer/apply, channel start/stop, project import) are 20. The aggregated audit report is 40. Start/stop-ALL-channels affects every channel on the instance in one call, same tier as a bulk action, so 60.
